description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing AccountTransferStandingInstruction entities, providing methods to query standing instructions based on loan or savings accounts and status.

classes.name: StandingInstructionRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for performing database operations related to AccountTransferStandingInstruction entities, including custom queries based on account type and status.

methods.name: findByLoanAccountAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves standing instructions associated with a specific loan account and status.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccountAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves standing instructions associated with a specific savings account and status.
